# <span id="aanchor175"></span> Applying a Master Allocation

After Master Allocation associations are created, the Master Allocation must be manually triggered to redistribute the volumes via the Master Allocation screen.

<div class="procedure">

To apply a Master Allocation:

1.  Go to **Tools** \> **Master Allocation** \> **Allocation**.
2.  Select a master allocation meter\location number or name and a contract month that you want allocated.
3.  Click **OK**.

When the process completes, the status window will display the following message, “Master meter/location allocation process completed”. If the allocation process fails to complete, an error message will display.

The allocation process will not complete if there are any unresolved exceptions for any meter members of the master meter or location within the specified time frame.
